newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to off.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders steady to off.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.100 cent per lb higher to 0.100 lower while feeder cattle were called steady to 0.100 lower, livestock analysts said.
Some analysts look for carryover technical support in live cattle futures after June held technical support near the 40-day average Wednesday and moved higher despite weak cash markets.
However, other analysts look for renewed pressure from cash. Boxed beef values declined and packers are not expected to bid for fed cattle until after the holiday, they said.
Cash cattle prices may have started their seasonal decline, they added.

Feeder cattle futures were seen showing early resistance despite the late rally Wednesday. Renewed pressure is likely following the slightly lower index and expectations of higher corn futures, they said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was off $0.02 to $76.35 per cwt.
